name: VEDCOCCINIL
shortDescription: A herbal alternative designed to help prevent and eliminate coccidia from the gut while supporting recovery and intestinal health.
fullDescription: Coccidiosis is a major parasitic condition affecting the intestinal tract of animals and birds. It can lead to weight loss, unhealthy carcasses, reduced production, developmental problems, and even death. VEDCOCCINIL provides a herbal alternative designed to help prevent and eliminate coccidia from the gut while supporting recovery and intestinal health.

name: VED CRD HERB
tagline: A unique herbal tonic for the respiratory tract
shortDescription: A herbal respiratory tonic blending medicinal herbs and essential oils to support the respiratory tract, ease congestion, and promote smooth breathing in poultry and livestock.
fullDescription: VED CRD HERB is a herbal respiratory tonic for poultry and livestock. It blends medicinal herbs and essential oils that offer mucolytic, expectorant, bronchodilator, anti-tussive, anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, anti-stress and antioxidant properties. The formulation supports the respiratory tract, eases congestion and promotes smooth breathing. As supportive therapy during respiratory infections, it helps relieve cough, sneezing and nasal blockage while reducing stress. When used as a growth promoter, it may help lower disease incidence, support performance and reduce mortality and production losses.

indications: Respiratory disease is among the most common ailments in poultry and a leading cause of mortality and production losses.

VED CRD HERB is a blend of medicinal herbs known to restrict the growth of Mycoplasma, bacteria and fungi. Its active ingredients also possess mucolytic, expectorant, bronchodilator, anti-tussive, anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, anti-stress, antioxidant and respiratory-tractsmoothing properties.
These herbs have shown promising results in conditions such as bronchitis, laryngitis and bronchial asthma. By helping to prevent various infections, the product is also useful as a growth promoter.
